0.original: This clumsy Mol maiden has broken something fairly important.

24.original: Slay three matamata and obtain a matamata matron shell and claw from a matamata matron.

25.original: Deliver the matamata matron shell and claw to the Mol maiden.

48.original: Please, you have to help me. I have broken the gifts I was supposed to give my soon-to-be husband's family. I need to fix them as soon as possible.

49.original: I require a matamata's shell and claw. However, I am incapable of obtaining them myself.

50.original: What is more, they must be taken from a matamata matron. A creature which is seldom seen.

51.original: Though, there is a way to draw one out into the open. Slay several matamata and one will appear eventually.

52.original: I was told to marry my husband by the elder gods themselves. This marriage <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> go ahead.

53.original: Slay the matamata to the west and a matron will appear soon enough.

54.original: Please bring its shell and a claw back to me. Without those I cannot repair the gifts.

56.original: Oh, thank you! I do not know what I would have done without you.

57.original: Our tribe is smaller than most. We try to prevent ourselves from becoming alienated from the other tribes by marrying our members with theirs.

58.original: It will take a while for me to get used to a life that is not controlled by the elder gods, but I know everything will be fine─it was they who chose this path for me.

59.original: Now, it is time I began repairing the gifts. Should our paths cross again someday, I would very much like to introduce you to my new family.
